recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition featuring a three-dimensional room corner defined by thin black lines. The scene contains a hand-drawn line-art sofa in the bottom right corner with three realistic figures seated on it, looking toward a massive, textured red monogram painted on the left wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the oversized wall graphic and the small seated figures
Juxtaposition of realistic photographic subjects against a sketch-style environment
Perspective lines converging in the upper right to create depth
Heavy red focal point balanced by the detailed cluster of figures in the lower right
coreInvariants: Stark white background with subtle paper texture
Thin, consistent black line weight for room boundaries and furniture
Deep crimson red for the primary graphic element
High-contrast lighting on the photographic subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures are scaled down and positioned in the lower right quadrant; the large monogram occupies the central left and middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red monogram acts as the primary anchor due to its color and size.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large red graphic, follows the gaze of the figures to the left, then moves up to the secondary text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space emphasizes the minimalist, conceptual nature of the 'room'.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background/walls) providing a clean, clinical canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (line work) defining the structure and perspective.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Crimson Red (monogram) used for branding and visual weight.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red graphic vs. desaturated, sketch-like surroundings.
paletteRestrictions: Natural skin tones and clothing colors for subjects

letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals on the bottom curves
Heavy, blocky weight for the monogram
Light, thin weight for secondary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Monogram letters share vertical strokes or are tightly nested
Secondary text features an open 'G' and high-waisted 'R'

composition.relationshipToImage: floating or painted high on wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast (Ultra-bold stencil vs. Ultra-light geometric sans).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton of the secondary text
Base for the monogram before customization

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a minimalist white room corner using thin black perspective lines. In the bottom right, place a hand-drawn black and white line-art sofa with three realistic young men sitting on it, looking toward the left wall. The overall style should be clean and sketch-like.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large crimson red stencil-style monogram on the left wall, skewed to match the perspective. Above it, add a line of thin, black geometric sans-serif text, also following the wall's perspective.

verificationChecks: Is the red graphic correctly skewed to the wall perspective?
Do the figures appear to be looking at the wall graphic?
Is the sofa rendered as a black and white line drawing?
Is there significant white space around the elements?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures on the sofa
mustRedesign: Exact facial likenesses of the subjects

mustAchieve: Integration of photo and sketch styles

postGenerationChecks: Check that the perspective lines meet at a single vanishing point.
Ensure the red graphic has a visible 'painted' or 'stamped' texture.
Verify the figures are high-contrast and sharp against the sketch background.
Confirm the stencil gaps in the monogram are clean and deliberate.
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist Perspective Room + [Subject Cluster in Sketch Style] + [Oversized Textured Wall Graphic] + [High-Contrast Typography]
